templates.title: Defend the Core
templates.summary: Walk to your core, place a Defend beacon beside it that guards the core and your commander, and stay inside its sphere.

templates.title: Expand & Mine
templates.summary: Place a Mine beacon covering a scrap seam you do not cover yet, and walk home while it digs.

templates.title: Hold & Build
templates.summary: Grow the grid: place a Build beacon covering a heat vent you do not cover yet, with a Generator on the vent as its first target, and hold by it.
templates.guided_pick_reason: Start with hold_and_build: it is the advisor's pick.

templates.title: Raid an Enemy Beacon
templates.summary: Walk to your core, place an Attack beacon beside it, and send its raiders against the nearest enemy beacon you know of.

templates.title: Safe playbook
templates.summary: Move to the safest beacon, raise the priority of any beacon about to brown out, then stay with the safest beacon.
